notes.title: The 2nd OBT Special Event
notes.content:
Dear Patchers, 

To express our gratitude to all beta testers, we present a special event as below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/a2e4c3626d4906b941bc6a6e35b7f3721567d47b.png

1. Hot Time Event

Event Period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
Time: 18:00~22:00 (PST) / 01:00~05:00(UTC) / 11:00~15:00(KST)
Event Details:
After each battle, the earned EXP and the Pigcell & Orgadyum from the Deathmatch, Battlefield, and Boss Raid will be doubled during the event hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/a4145a00bead08822eee5bdccf90f1a0910574c6.png

2-1. Achieve Level 10!

Event Period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
Event Reward: The 2nd OBT Special Pack (to be given on the official launch)
How to Participate:
Please leave a reply on this post with your Steam account that you are participating in and achieve account level 10(Sniffer II) or higher. You are eligible to receive the reward. When the game is officially launched, you will receive the reward.


2-2. Special Merchandise Giveaway

Event period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
Event Reward: "The Patcher" merchandise package (Total 10 Patchers)
How to Participate:
Participate in the event 2-1 and among those, the top ten highest account level patchers will receive the reward. If more than ten users with the highest account level, they will be selected on a first-come, first-served basis. The top ten winners will be asked their postal address to receive the merchandise reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/5fff8be4516008970907d7bd203e15212f37c0fc.png

Participate in the events to make sure you make the most of its magnificent benefits. See you in game!

Thank You.

Pixelity Games “The Patcher” Operation team


Event Notice

The event 2-2 winners will be asked their postal address in accordance with Privacy Policy. If a winner does not wish to agree with the terms, the reward will be given to the next ranked participant.
Pixelity Games reserves the right to change or cancel the event depending on mitigating circumstances.
Any changes to the event will be made on this page.
Participating in the event using inappropriate methods or violating Terms of Service may result in the cancellation or retrieval of your reward, as well as restrictions from the game.
If you have any questions about this event, please send a ticket through [Support].

notes.title: The 2nd Open Beta has started!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iy8gSYVJaIU;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear Patchers,

The 2nd Open Beta of “The Patcher” has begun!

Press the "Demo" button on the store page to install or update.

For this Open Beta, we offer you the new content as below.

[olist]
Boss Raid Mode

A large-scale combat mode in PvPvE: both camps have to clash against each other while the giant boss Tantalus is in the center attacks both camps.
Various rewards provided from each mission in the Boss-Raid




New weapons
Diversification in functions and stat such as attack types and range
Able to obtain through account level-up, Battlefield bosses rewards, Boss-Raid rewards, or store purchases

New skills: ‘Execution’ & ‘Dash’
Execution: eliminate the opponent with a sword. 
Dash: widens and narrows the distance from the opponent instantly.
Able to obtain these skills from the cartridges.

Main UI improvement
Major UI/UX reorganization
Introduction of equippable weapon inventory

Tutorial
In-game voice improvement

Fixed minor bugs 
[/olist]
If you have any inconveniences or suggestions during the gameplay, please email feedback@pixelitygames.com. 

Your support will help us significantly enhance the "The Patcher's" completeness through this 2nd open beta. Also, if you kindly leave an email on the pre-registration page or join our Discord channel, we will deliver the latest news.

Thank You,

Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team


*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialized after the test period.

notes.title: The Patcher's 1st Open Beta started!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/690f24af67e5b4a172dcfac4701ba9f2fff0ffd8.png

Dear Patchers,

The first beta test of “The Patcher” has started!

You can install or update through 'DEMO' button!

This time, we introduce some new features and improve the existing contents.


New Hunting Ground: Battlefield
New Game System: Shop and Skills
Tutorial and Deathmatch improved
Optimization and minor bugs fixed
Valve Index and HP Reverb G2 support


In addition, as you play the game, if there is anything to share and suggest, please feel free to post on the Steam community or send us an Email to feedback@pixelitygames.com. We will review your words to improve our game. Your valuable opinions will be appreciated.

Through this beta, we would like to ask for your support for “The Patcher” to make the game perfect.

Also, if you leave your Email address on the pre-registration page, we will share the latest news about "The Patcher" right away!

Thank you.

Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team


*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialised after the test period.
